article.title: 2 [Alternative relief in divorce proceedings.
article.content: In any proceeding under this Act, on a petition for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce, except insofar as the petition is founded on the ground mentioned in clause (h) of sub-section (1) of section 27, the court may, if it considers it just so to do having regard to the circumstances of the case, pass instead a decree for judicial separation.]
article.html:
27A2[Alternative relief in divorce proceedings.

Section 27A · Chapter VI · page 14 of the Act

In any proceeding under this Act, on a petition for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce, except insofar as the petition is founded on the ground mentioned in clause (h) of sub-section (1) of section 27, the court may, if it considers it just so to do having regard to the circumstances of the case, pass instead a decree for judicial separation.]

2 Ins. by Act 68 of 1976, s. 28 (w.e.f. 27-5-1976).
